title: Budget and expenses
audience: For anyone who wants to know where the money went without a budgeting app.
description: An expense log with a monthly budget. Tell your AI what you spent and it logs it; at month end it compares you to budget.
tagline: What you spend, against a monthly budget.
seoTitle: Budget and expense log template for ChatGPT and Claude

## Month summaries

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Budget and expenses". When I tell you what I spent, add a row to the first table with log_table_row: Date as yyyy-mm-dd, What, a Category from its options, and Amount as a number. At the end of the month, when I ask, read both tables with read_table, add up each category against "Monthly budget", and add a short summary under "Month summaries" with append_to_note: what was over, what was under, and one suggestion. Don't give financial advice beyond that.

asks: Spent 412 on groceries and 85 on the bus card today.
How am I doing against the budget this month?
What did we spend on eating out in September?

args.text: **September:** eating out was 1,840 against 1,500, mostly two dinners in the last week. Groceries came in 300 under. Suggestion: plan two more dinners at home next month.
